title: Data Analyst — Entry Level
description: Representative sample job description. Analyze business data, clean datasets, write SQL queries, build dashboards, and communicate insights to stakeholders. Required: SQL, Excel, Python, data analysis, data cleaning, visualization, statistics, reporting, KPI analysis. Preferred: Power BI, Tableau, Pandas, Git. 0-2 years of relevant analytical experience.

title: Data Analyst — SQL + Power BI
description: Representative sample job description. Build reliable SQL queries, transform data, develop Power BI dashboards, monitor KPIs, and present findings to business teams. Required: SQL, Power BI, Excel, data modeling, dashboarding, reporting, KPI analysis, stakeholder communication. Preferred: Python, Pandas, DAX, ETL. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Data Analyst — Mid Level
description: Representative sample job description. Own analytical projects from requirements through delivery, perform advanced SQL and Python analysis, develop BI dashboards, conduct statistical analysis and A/B testing, and translate findings into recommendations. Required: advanced SQL, Python, Pandas, Power BI or Tableau, data modeling, ETL, dashboarding, stakeholder management, statistical analysis, KPI development. Preferred: dbt, cloud, experimentation. 2+ years of experience.

title: Operations Data Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Analyze operational performance, automate recurring reports, identify process bottlenecks, and build dashboards for operational KPIs. Required: SQL, Excel, Python, reporting, KPI analysis, data visualization, process improvement. Preferred: Power BI, ETL, statistics. 2+ years of experience.

title: Financial Data Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Support financial reporting, forecasting, variance analysis, and dashboarding. Required: Excel, SQL, financial analysis, forecasting, reporting, KPI analysis. Preferred: Python, Power BI, statistics. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Data Scientist — Entry Level
description: Representative sample job description. Explore datasets, engineer features, train and evaluate machine-learning models, and communicate results. Required: Python, SQL, Pandas, NumPy, statistics, machine learning, scikit-learn, feature engineering, model evaluation, EDA, visualization, Git. Preferred: XGBoost, NLP, cloud. 0-2 years of experience.

title: Data Scientist — Machine Learning
description: Representative sample job description. Develop production-oriented machine-learning solutions, perform feature engineering, cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning, and partner with engineering teams on deployment. Required: Python, SQL, machine learning, scikit-learn, feature engineering, model evaluation, statistics, experimentation. Preferred: XGBoost, cloud, Docker, APIs. 2+ years of experience.

title: Applied Data Scientist — NLP
description: Representative sample job description. Build NLP pipelines, evaluate machine-learning models, analyze unstructured data, and communicate experimental findings. Required: Python, machine learning, NLP, statistics, scikit-learn, feature engineering, model evaluation. Preferred: deep learning, PyTorch, APIs, Docker. 2+ years of experience.

title: Data Scientist — Forecasting
description: Representative sample job description. Build forecasting models, conduct time-series analysis, validate models, and communicate uncertainty. Required: Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, time series, model evaluation. Preferred: cloud, XGBoost, experimentation. 2+ years of experience.

title: Machine Learning / Applied Data Science
description: Representative sample job description. Prepare data, train models, evaluate performance, and support deployment through APIs and containers. Required: Python, machine learning, scikit-learn, feature engineering, model evaluation, statistics. Preferred: deep learning, NLP, Docker, APIs, cloud. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Business Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Gather requirements, analyze operational data, define KPIs, create reports, and communicate findings to stakeholders. Required: SQL, Excel, requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, reporting, KPI analysis, business analysis, process improvement. Preferred: Power BI, Python. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Build semantic data models, SQL transformations, dashboards, and executive reporting. Required: SQL, Power BI, Tableau, DAX, ETL, data modeling, dashboarding, KPI analysis. Preferred: dbt, Snowflake, Python. 2+ years of experience.

title: Reporting Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Produce recurring business reports, automate reporting workflows, validate data, and maintain KPI dashboards. Required: SQL, Excel, reporting, dashboarding, data visualization, KPI analysis. Preferred: Power BI, Python, ETL. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Product Data Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Analyze user behavior, funnels, cohorts, retention, and experiments to improve product decisions. Required: SQL, Python, product analytics, funnel analysis, cohort analysis, retention, A/B testing, experimentation, product KPIs. Preferred: Power BI, Tableau, causal inference. 2+ years of experience.

title: Marketing Data Analyst
description: Representative sample job description. Analyze campaigns, acquisition channels, conversion, ROI, and attribution. Required: SQL, Python, Excel, Google Analytics, marketing analytics, campaign analysis, conversion rate, ROI, attribution, dashboarding. Preferred: Power BI, Tableau. 1-3 years of experience.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: Representative sample job description. Build reliable analytical datasets and transformation pipelines, model warehouse data, and support self-service analytics. Required: SQL, data modeling, ETL, dbt, Git, cloud. Preferred: Python, Airflow, Snowflake, Spark. 2+ years of experience.
